name: Distance Color Blending
definition: A technique to enhance depth perception by dimming colors and shifting them towards a background color (often blue for aerial perspective) as they recede from the viewer, using an exponential function for non-linear progression.
summary: Distance Color Blending enhances depth perception in volume rendering by blending voxel colors with a background hue based on distance, distinguishing itself by targeting global depth cues rather than local geometry lighting.
